title: Hopf algebras over Chevalley groups
summary: We show that every finite-dimensional pointed Hopf algebra over a finite simple Chevalley group, different from $PSL_2(q)$ with q= 3 mod 4 (and from $PSL_3(2)\simeq PSL_2(7)$), is isomorphic to the corresponding group algebra. To do this, we complete the analysis of the Nichols algebras of Yetter-Drinfeld modules over such groups whose support is a semisimple orbit, begun in arXiv:1506.06794, arXiv:2301.03361.
